subject: the ear seen from the side and a little from the front
reference_style: Monster Hunter Stories 3 (MHS3) anime toon style, adult male

ear_outline.reference: A smooth dark outer outline round the top and back of the ear, continuous where the top of the ear meets the head.
ear_outline.ours: A smooth dark outer outline round the top, back and lobe of the ear, with a short gap at the front of the top where the ear meets the head.

inner_line.reference: One thin dark line inside the ear: it starts under the rim at the top, runs down along the front side of the inner shadow and ends above the lobe, forming a C shape open to the back.
inner_line.ours: One thin dark line inside the ear along the front side of the inner shadow, from the top down to above the lobe, forming a C shape open to the back; it is thinnest at the top.

inner_shadow.reference: A mauve, pinkish-brown crescent of shadow inside the ear: wide at the top under the rim, narrowing toward the bottom; behind it a lit cream strip, then the lit rim along the back; the lobe is lit.
inner_shadow.ours: A mauve, pinkish-brown crescent of shadow inside the ear: wide at the top, narrowing toward the bottom; its back edge is ragged (small steps); behind it lit skin up to the rim along the back; the lobe is lit.

ear_light.reference: The ear's rim and lobe are lit cream skin while the head skin beside the ear is in shadow.
ear_light.ours: The ear's rim and lobe are lit skin while the head skin beside the ear is in shadow.

ear_shape.reference: Tall rounded ear, broad at the top, narrowing to a small lobe, leaning back a little; width about half the height.
ear_shape.ours: Tall rounded ear, broad at the top, narrowing to a small lobe, leaning back a little; width about half the height.
